subject.title: External issue implementation intake queues work that the repair allowlist rejects

question: Should the hosted ClawSweeper instance execute repair jobs for approved `steipete/*` repositories, or should those repositories remain review-only until separately authorized?
rationale: The code can mechanically share one policy, but choosing which external repositories receive branch and PR mutation authority changes the hosted service's security boundary and cannot be inferred safely from the contradictory intake and executor settings.

options.title: Fail closed to executable scope
options.body: Gate all durable intake on a shared explicit repository allowlist and treat `steipete/oracle` as review-only until both GitHub App and CrabFleet authorization are deliberately configured.

options.title: Authorize selected external repairs
options.body: Add an explicit repository allowlist containing approved `steipete/*` targets and update GitHub App, executor, and CrabFleet policy together before intake queues them.

recommendation.title: Fail closed to executable scope
recommendation.body: Gate all durable intake on a shared explicit repository allowlist and treat `steipete/oracle` as review-only until both GitHub App and CrabFleet authorization are deliberately configured.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work connects this person to repair dispatch recovery and issue-implementation run handling across the affected worker path.
